title: Two-tape effective coding
statement: Every effective machine coding scheme whose decoded machines have two work tapes gives an effective coding scheme for two-work-tape machines, with each Boolean word decoding to the same machine and with its canonizer computing the fixed serialization of that machine.
hypotheses_covered: an effective two-work-tape machine coding scheme
